svg.title: Valdara Industries, Serra 180 – Side frame VI-C180, ductile cast iron (VI-DWG-B180-002)
svg.text: back rail, front face 18° to vertical
Bolt holes Ø10 through flange, 2 per point at x = web ±20
hole rail y z (from A) axis
2 Walls 7 mm (web and flanges); concave radii R10, edges R4.
3 Draft 1.5° on faces normal to the parting plane (web mid-plane).
4 Symmetric about the web mid-plane: one casting for both sides.
5 Open T-sections only, no closed cavities (EN ISO 14713-2);
hang for galvanising from the anchor holes, armrest down.
6 Blast-clean (grit/shot) to remove sand and surface graphite; hot-dip
galvanise EN ISO 1461 (≥ 80 µm mean; about 200 µm expected, reactive iron);
sweep-blast, powder coat 70 µm, RAL 7011 / 6005 approx.
7 Pattern shrinkage 1.0 %; tolerances ISO 8062-3 DCTG 10; holes drilled ±0.3.
8 Melt number cast in (loose letters, per casting day); serial number
hard-stamped on the inside of the rear leg after fettling.
Serra 180 – Side frame VI-C180, ductile cast iron
EN-GJS-400-15 (EN 1563, 5.3106) mass 10.2 kg cast, 11.1 kg coated
